about_the_game:
Exhilarating Swordplay Action!

Soar through the battlefield, slicing enemies into pieces and kicking them away in this high-speed slashing 3D action game! Cut through enemies, missiles, trees, rocks, and even the environment around you to gain the upper hand in battle. When you defeat an enemy, time slows down—experience the thrill of slashing them from any angle before sending them flying with a kick!

Deflect Enemy Attacks with Perfect Guards!

Utilize the "Nagashi" system, a just guard mechanic that allows you to effortlessly deflect incoming attacks. Experience the satisfaction of chaining perfect guards and seamlessly transitioning into a counterattack to carve through your foes. The game offers two modes: one that delivers a high-difficulty parry action experience similar to Souls-like games, and another that provides a more casual, stylish action approach. Even players who struggle with high-difficulty action games will be able to enjoy exhilarating parry mechanics with ease.

Dominate the Battlefield with Wire Action!

The protagonist can use wire action to rapidly move to targeted locations such as tree branches or rooftops. Additionally, trees and rocks can be pulled toward the player, allowing them to be sliced, kicked, and used as weapons. Utilize the environment to your advantage—hide in high places, use massive boulders as projectiles, and take control of the battlefield with dynamic wire-based combat!

Clash with Gigantic Karakuri!

Face off against towering Karakuri machines! Use perfect guards to evade missiles and enemy attacks while slicing through their weak points. Destroy specific parts to limit their offensive capabilities, then kick the severed parts back at them for additional damage. And of course, in the end, you can completely dismantle these massive Karakuri with your blade!

World Setting

This game presents a unique Japanese-inspired sci-fi world. While drawing inspiration from Japan’s Edo period, it introduces a world where a portal to another dimension—opened by mysterious mechanical arts—unleashes the threat of Karakuri, fearsome mechanical invaders.
